description: Turn fake pixel art (an AI image or an upscaled screenshot where each "pixel" is a blurry block of slightly different colours) into real pixel art: finds the pixel grid, rebuilds it at 1 pixel per cell with one clean colour per cell, and can limit the colours or map them to a palette. Removes a fake checkerboard background first.

cell.description: Size of one art pixel in the source, if you know it. Found automatically when left out.

image_base64.description: The PNG file as base64 (a data: URL also works). Use instead of image_url.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG image, up to about 128×128 pixels.

name.description: Short name for the output files.

outline.description: Add a 1 pixel dark outline around the sprite.

palette.description: Map to a palette: pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, gameboy, nes-like, or hex codes like "#1a1c2c #b13e53 ...".

scale.description: Also save a copy scaled up this many times with sharp pixels.

name: fix_pixel_art
title: Fix fake pixel art
